courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 三峽升船機
related.transfer: 可遷移「船廂水位與額外質量」與「配重行程與幾何邊界」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；三峽升船機的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Caisson level and extra mass" and "Counterweight travel and geometric limits" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Three Gorges ship lift must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦纜索承載、雙船廂獨立性與高架航道銜接；三峽升船機則以高提升船廂的配重、齒條同步與對接邊界為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cable load sharing, independent caissons and elevated-reach interfaces; Three Gorges ship lift centres on counterweights, rack synchronization and docking boundaries of a high-lift caisson, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「船廂水位與額外質量」與「船舶排水與船廂質量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到三峽升船機，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「對接水位差作用」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Caisson level and extra mass” and “Vessel displacement and caisson mass”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Three Gorges ship lift, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Docking head-difference force", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 福爾柯克水輪
related.transfer: 可遷移「船廂水位與額外質量」與「配重行程與幾何邊界」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；福爾柯克水輪的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Caisson level and extra mass" and "Counterweight travel and geometric limits" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Falkirk Wheel must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦纜索承載、雙船廂獨立性與高架航道銜接；福爾柯克水輪則以旋轉升船的浮力平衡、齒輪定向與循環能量為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cable load sharing, independent caissons and elevated-reach interfaces; Falkirk Wheel centres on buoyant balance, geared orientation and cycle energy in a rotating boat lift, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「船廂水位與額外質量」與「成對船槽質量平衡」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到福爾柯克水輪，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「螺栓預拉與接觸」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Caisson level and extra mass” and “Paired gondola mass balance”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Falkirk Wheel, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Bolt pretension and joint contact", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機
history.text: 斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機以兩座獨立船廂跨越中央運河的大高差，官方資料提供纜索式升船機與齒條式系統的比較脈絡。官方旅遊機構歷史摘要記錄工程於一九八二年開始。 瓦隆與SOFICO官方資料確認升船機於二〇〇二年投入服務。 機電手冊更新提供纜索設備分析背景，並非升船機改建事件。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。
history.textEn: Strepy-Thieu uses two independent caissons to bridge a large level difference on the Canal du Centre, providing public context for comparing cable-driven and rack-driven lifts. The official tourism history summary records construction beginning in nineteen eighty-two. Walloon and SOFICO sources confirm the lift entering service in two thousand two. Updated mechanical guidance supplies cable-equipment analysis context, not a reconstruction event at the lift. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.
